9958dcfe79c7dcfa9657bf6710ac6433077bb4fa.summary: Silent Push reports that FIN7 (also called Sangria Tempest), a financially motivated group with ties to Russia, is running fake AI adult-image generator sites. Visitors are lured by free download and free trial offers that deliver Redline Stealer, D3F@ck Loader and Lumma Stealer. Separately, FIN7 runs NetSupport RAT malvertising using .MSIX files. The report says the AI generator sites were taken down after escalations, and it expects new sites to follow similar patterns.
